bosses.name: Venomfrill
bosses.blurb: The current world boss. A frilled, mutated venomous lizard — hits Physical and is weak to Physical.
bosses.source: Stats and full kit current as of the live version; per-hit damage values pending.

mechanics.name: Extreme damage feeds his resistance
mechanics.text: Every hit from an Extreme skill stacks an Extreme-resist buff on him — up to 4 stacks through Rank 4, 6 at Endless, ~20s each — and at Endless he opens with a permanent one. Since firing Extremes is your main input, that's a real tension: leaning on them for raw damage makes each one land softer. Let your units' auto-attacks carry the damage against his Physical weakness, and spend Extremes on timing and utility rather than as your damage engine.

mechanics.name: The kit unlocks by rank
mechanics.text: Higher ranks aren't just more HP. Rank 1 is three basic attacks plus a stagger hit. Rank 2 adds a four-part dash rush and a fog attack. Rank 3 and up add a long, telegraphed roar. Expect a busier, more punishing rotation the higher you climb.

mechanics.name: Dash rush (Rank 2+)
mechanics.text: A four-hit dash combo (four ~2s lunges) that he banks charges for on roughly a 30-second cooldown. Your units won't sidestep it on their own, so it's a raw durability check — bring enough front-line survivability to eat the combo, and if you run a defensive or counter Extreme, the dash-ready window is when to spend it.

mechanics.name: Roar (Rank 3+)
mechanics.text: His longest move at about 10.5 seconds, so it's heavily telegraphed. Since when you fire Extremes is the main thing you control, treat that long windup as a clean window to land a big Extreme.

mechanics.name: Endless revive (Rank 5)
mechanics.text: In Endless he revives after going down and returns with an extra-damage buff. Save an Extreme for the second phase instead of dumping everything before the first knockdown.

mechanics.name: Hard to lock down
mechanics.text: Extremely high knockback and stagger resistance make stuns and interrupts unreliable — he powers through most CC. He can still be pulled or teleported, and he never dodges or blocks, so no hits are wasted. Plan for sustained Physical pressure over a stun-lock.

tips: Weak to Physical — Physical dealers top the ranked list below.
Very high knockback resistance and posture — far tougher to interrupt than the previous slime boss — so CC and stun-locks are unreliable; lean on sustained Physical damage and survivability instead.
Beast race — relevant for any race-targeted effects.

past_bosses.name: Abyssal Slime
past_bosses.blurb: World boss — compete for the highest score, measured by total damage dealt before you die or the timer runs out.

mechanics.name: Slam
mechanics.text: Slams the targeted hero for heavy AoE damage to that unit and everyone near it, and applies heavy Stagger.

mechanics.name: Map-wide Knockback
mechanics.text: Guaranteed right after he exits a knockdown (unless he is CC'd as it ends), and occasionally outside that window. Knocks every unit back with heavy damage and a stun. This is the one to interrupt — CC him as the knockdown ends to cancel it.

mechanics.name: Water Pull
mechanics.text: Drags all units to the center of the map three times, dealing damage on each pull and briefly stunning/interrupting everyone. Save Extremes for just before or after — casting during it risks being interrupted or outranged.

tips: Weak to Mental — Mental dealers post the highest scores.
Bring one reliable stun to cancel the Map-wide Knockback (see control units below).
Time Extremes around the Water Pull, not during it — the pull + stun makes a mid-cast Extreme a gamble.
Score is cumulative damage before you die, so survivability and uptime matter as much as burst.

recommended.note: Mental DoT + execute — strong sustained score.
Mental burst — her Extreme also stuns, but it does big bonus damage to knocked-down targets, so land it DURING a knockdown rather than spending it to cancel the wake-up.
Carmen — Extreme stun times the Wake-up Kickback; peels/heals.

control.note: Carmen — Extreme stun; time it to the knockdown ending to cancel the kickback.
Dusan — very readable timing between the hits and the CC, making the interrupt easy to land.
Xini — Extreme applies a knockdown (surfaced from her skill text); useful control, confirm timing in-run.
